02452: In the fourteenth year of Chenghua, a crimson meteor tore across the sky. A huge meteorite fell in the heart of the Central Plains; mountains and rivers shifted and cities collapsed. The histories call this night "the Sky Lantern Calamity".
02453: The Chenghua Emperor ordered that the common people not discuss the matter, to calm the public's panic.
02454: But word of it spread far among the people, and they rushed to see for themselves. Many took the "Sky Lantern" as a warning from the heavens, a sign that the fate of the realm would change.
02455: At the bottom of the crater, people found veins of glowing crystal. This ore gave off scorching energy without end, and could even make the plants around it stir with no wind. People named it "Star Crystal".
02456: The energy the Star Crystal brought set the Central Plains boiling. People used all kinds of ingenious mechanisms to harness its power; craftsmen set Star Crystals inside mechanical beasts, and steam gushed out between their bronze scales.
02457: Gear-driven fortress towns clad in iron sheeting rose from the ground.
02458: A frenzied scramble swept the martial world. The Qingcheng Sect smelted Star Crystal into swords that cut iron like mud, the Tang Sect built repeating fire-tubes packed with crystal shards, and the eminent monks of Shaolin even reached a new level of the Golden Bell Shield.
02459: The Xuanyuan Sect, which had mastered the art of refining Star Crystal, was massacred on a dark and windy night, and its thousand-year-old library was swallowed by fire.
02460: The young Sect Master broke out with a handful of others and fled by carriage through the starlit night...
02461: Seven days later, the group strayed into a valley wrapped in clouds and mist;
02462: In the mist they ran into a strange boulder, and their supplies were destroyed.
02463: They found hot springs bubbling between the bluestones here, and deep in the pool shone the faint blue glow peculiar to Star Crystal...
02464: Once the old home of the Chixia Sword Sect. Sword marks are still cut deep into the broken walls, the scripture pavilion famed across the martial world lies in ruins, and at dawn and dusk a sword's ringing often sounds like weeping.
02465:
Once the Wandu Sect's forbidden valley: thick with poison mist, yet bursting with life.
Pros: the driest spring of the three.
Cons: the coldest start (10 degrees), with snow and blizzards in winter.
02466:
A lone island far out at sea, beyond the reach of the Central Plains. Tales of pirate treasure draw hunters here, and pirates sometimes land for water.
Pros: the warmest start (20 degrees), and it never snows.
Cons: frequent storms and heavy rain.
02467: A disciple is robbed by bandits at a mountain pass
02468: At a pass between two mountains, seven or eight burly men in black headscarves burst out of the woods ahead, sabers in hand. Their leader sneers and blocks the middle of the road, demanding a toll for passage. If the disciple won't back down, there'll be no avoiding a tangle with this band of thugs.
02469: A disciple is given guidance by a master on an old road
02470: Traveling alone on an old road almost no one uses, the disciple suddenly sees a strange-looking white-haired old man standing in the shade of a pine ahead. He gives no name; with only a few words he seems to point straight at the key to the martial arts, and the disciple dares not take him lightly.
02471: A disciple is provoked by a drunk in a tavern
02472: At nightfall, the disciple orders a pot of cloudy wine in a small, nameless tavern in town. A few men at the next table, warm with drink, start saying uglier and uglier things, and in a few lines they have turned on this stranger from out of town.
02473: A disciple gathers a rare herb by a mountain stream
02474: With some time to spare on the adventure, the disciple strolls out of town and sees a mountain stream running down the foot of a cliff. A few green leaves peek out of the cracks in the rocks beside it; they look like a herb rarely seen. With a little effort, there may be something to gain.
02475: A disciple saves a wandering swordsman from an ambush
02476: Beside the highway, the disciple suddenly sees a hand stick out of the grass, waving weakly. Up close it turns out to be a young man in an old robe, wounded in the chest but with a fiercely stubborn look. He says he was ambushed and refuses to die out in the wilds.
02477: A disciple nearly falls off a cliff on a slippery mountain path
02478: On the way back along a cliffside path, last night's mountain rain has left the stone steps slick. As the disciple rounds a bend, a foot slips on the moss, and the disciple nearly falls, pack and all.
02479: A disciple runs into a fake treasure scam at the market
02480: At the crowded market south of the city, an honest-looking middle-aged man stops the disciple and furtively opens a bundle. He says with a low laugh that he got a treasure from some rich man's black market, and the price is a real bargain.
02481: A disciple is enlightened by a monk in an abandoned temple
02482: Partway through the adventure, a distant bell draws the disciple to an abandoned old temple halfway up a mountain. The gate has half collapsed and dust covers the hall, yet in the middle sits a monk, still as a pine, as if waiting for someone fated to come.
02483: A disciple is attacked by assassins at an inn at night
02484: Close to the third watch, the inn's window lattice is suddenly flicked open by a silver thread as fine as a hair. The disciple wakes with a start to see three dark figures slip in through the window, landing without a sound, cold and menacing.
02485: A disciple helps an old woman and a child bury their dead
02486: On the highway outside the city gate, the disciple sees an old woman and a child kneeling in the dust beside a thin coffin covered with coarse cloth. The old woman chokes back sobs, begging passers-by for a little help so the dead can be buried.
02487: A disciple shelters from a sandstorm with strangers at an abandoned post house
02488: At sunset a sandstorm rises and blots out the sky. The disciple finds a half-collapsed, abandoned post house to shelter in. A few travelers with indistinct faces are already curled up inside, and no one wants to speak first. The firelight on each face makes them all look like they are hiding something.
02489: A disciple meets a Beggar Sect branch head in a ruined city
02490: Outside a broken temple in a ruined city, a white-haired old man carrying nine iron bells blocks the way. He calls himself the head of the Beggar Sect's branch beyond the frontier, and asks with a smile whether the disciple, having come so far, has heard the latest news from the borderlands.
02491: A disciple is robbed by horse bandits in the desert
02492: A line of yellow dust rises on the horizon, and a dozen or more mounted bandits come whooping in, their curved blades glaring white in the blazing sun. Their leader reins in across the road and shouts an order to halt. Clearly it's not just travel money they're after.
02493: A disciple grasps the intent of the fist in Damo Cave
02494: A mountain path leads the disciple to a sunless stone cave on the back slope. On the walls are faint traces of fist intent left by masters of old who faced the wall in meditation. The disciple focuses for a long time and feels the clamor in the heart slowly fade, as if some understanding is breaking through the soil.
02495: A disciple ponders a Daoist riddle at Laojun Temple
02496: At a Daoist temple halfway up the mountain, an old Daoist with white hair and beard is sweeping fallen leaves. When the disciple comes up into the temple he doesn't even look up, just hands over a wooden slip about a foot long and asks what it means. A few short phrases, yet they seem to hide a deep secret.
02497: A disciple is troubled by an inner demon in a meditation room at night
02498: Spending the night in a meditation room, the disciple feels the art practiced during the day stirring restlessly in the Dantian. Half asleep, a voice just like the disciple's own laughs softly deep in the heart, as if dragging up every thought usually kept down.
02499: A disciple boards a painted boat for a poetry gathering of talented ladies
02500: As dusk falls, red lantern light sways on West Lake, and a painted boat with carved beams is moored in the willows' shade. A young lady in blue comes over holding a small brazier and invites the disciple aboard to hear music and write poems. The talk at the table is all romance and idle chatter, yet every line seems to hide something.
02501: A disciple finds a mysterious old casket in a pawnshop
02502: Ducking out of the rain into the old Hengfeng pawnshop, the disciple sees a dull old casket on the innermost shelf, yet beneath the brass fittings on its corners there's an unusual sheen. The shopkeeper only smiles and says just that those with the right fate may look at it.
02503: A disciple settles a dispute between two merchant guilds
02504: Two silk merchant guilds are fighting over profit in the street, each sticking to its own story. Seeing that the disciple is a passing traveler of the jianghu, both turn their eyes on you, as if hoping you'll give a fair verdict.
02505: A disciple catches ruffians assaulting a woman in a lane
02506: Heading back to the inn at night, the disciple turns into a narrow lane hung with red lanterns. Three or four ruffians have a crying woman cornered against a wall. Their leader laughs and jokes lewdly; this is clearly not the first time he has done this.
02507: A disciple is shaken down by the Harbor Gang on a night ferry
02508: The disciple takes a night ferry across the river. In midstream, several Harbor Gang men with sabers suddenly turn nasty, crowding the old boatman and demanding money for the crossing. The boat rocks hard as the river wind hits them in the face.
02509: A disciple sees the Qian Gang shaking down dockside merchants
02510: On the dock, with the morning mist not yet gone, a band of Qian Gang men wearing waist tokens marked "Dragon" are going from door to door collecting gang dues. A white-haired old man grumbles under his breath that the cut is too heavy, but doesn't dare raise his voice.
02511: A disciple is taken into a black market for smuggled salt in a dark alley
02512: After the night market closes, a shifty man pulls the disciple into a dark alley. Down below are sacks of smuggled salt and a few rusty short blades, with people quietly haggling nearby. The mood is strange.
02513: A disciple comes upon a smuggling ship on a stormy night
02514: Sea and sky are pitch black. As the porters near the dock, a heavily laden cargo ship slips in. Its sweating captain grabs every man who passes, as if waiting for someone to take on this job.
02515: A disciple receives an invitation to the Tianxia Society's trial banquet
02516: The Tianxia Society, the most famous in the imperial capital, is holding a grand trial banquet at its villa in the east of the city, inviting celebrities and rising talents. Just as the disciple is wondering about it, a gate boy hands over an invitation at the front door, as if deliberately testing.
02517: A disciple stumbles on a powerful family's secret deal at midnight
02518: Taking a shortcut late at night through the back alley behind a high wall with a vermilion gate, the disciple comes upon two dark figures handing over heavy chests. In the moonlight the two are well dressed, yet move with unusual care.
02519: A disciple receives a red death notice at an inn at night
02520: Resting at an inn in the imperial capital, the disciple's fingertips touch an ice-cold blood-red note under the pillow. It is a red death notice. It is signed with only a few words, yet it spells out where you are staying tonight and where you are going.
02521: A disciple is challenged to a duel on a stone bridge
02522: Passing a stone bridge, the disciple sees someone has already set up a ring in its middle, declaring that he is waiting only for martial artists to test against. Water burbles under the bridge and cheers ring out on it. Win or lose, taking up this fight is bound to get people talking.
02523: A disciple hears the secrets of an old case in a ruined temple
02524: A sudden downpour drives the disciple into a ruined temple for shelter, where a few travelers by the fire are talking quietly about an old case. In their scraps of talk there is both a blood debt and a secret object lost for years. It's hard not to listen.
02525: A disciple is hired by a traveling merchant to escort goods
02526: Traders crowd the ferry crossing. A merchant carrying goods, worried he'll be marked on the road, quietly asks the disciple to escort him for a stretch. It seems like a small thing, but once on the road it becomes clear that more than one band has its eye on this cargo.
02527: A disciple tests a traveling doctor's secret medicine on the street
02528: A wandering jianghu doctor has set up a small stall at the street corner, boasting of medicine that cures old hidden injuries. The disciple means to laugh it off, but the onlookers all wear different expressions, as if there's more to this stall than meets the eye.
02529: A disciple helps a woman find her child at a temple fair
02530: Gongs and drums thunder at the temple fair when a woman suddenly bursts into tears: her child is lost in the crowd. If the disciple will help, clues must be found fast amid the din; once the crowd scatters, the trail will be much harder to follow.
02531: A blacksmith asks a disciple to settle an old debt
02532: The old man in the smithy stares at the weapon at the disciple's waist for a long time, then suddenly sighs and mentions a debt left unsettled for years. He is vague about who the creditor is and what the grudge was, yet insists on asking the disciple to go in his place.
02533: A courier asks a disciple to hold off pursuers
02534: Under the moon, a courier comes running down the highway drenched in sweat, with someone faintly giving chase behind. He doesn't dare stop for long and just begs the disciple to hold them off for him; before he finishes speaking, he is already stumbling on.
02535: A disciple solves an endgame and grasps a martial truth
02536: At a chess stall on a street corner, an old man has set up an endgame no one can solve. The disciple is just passing by, but the old man suddenly looks up and invites the disciple to play. A few pieces are placed, and the position seems to hint at another layer of martial truth.
02537: A disciple investigates suspicious contraband at a ghost market
02538: At a night market down a side lane, goods that can't see the light of day are quietly laid out under a few dim lamps. The seller says little, only that those who know quality will name a price. Up close, the disciple can tell this deal is more than simple buying and selling.
02539: A disciple digs up an old casket and starts a scramble
02540: An old casket turns up while turning the soil of a wasteland. The clay seal is unbroken, but the news has already spread. All sorts of people come running, each wanting to be first to know what's inside.
02541: A monk's Chan question lays bare a martial key for a disciple
02542: While seeking lodging on the road, the disciple meets a monk who blocks the way to ask a question: why, in the end, does a traveler travel? The few lines of Chan wit mean no harm, yet the disciple's heart trembles slightly, as if a long-unsolved key has been gently laid bare.
02543: A disciple is drawn into a blood feud between two sects over an old sword
02544: Outside a weapon shop, an old sword of unknown origin has two groups fighting over it. Some say it was a famous hero's weapon; others insist it carries a blood debt. Before many words are exchanged, swords are drawn and bows are bent.
02545: A disciple finds signs of arson after a fire rescue
02546: A house is on fire, with thick smoke billowing. After the disciple steps in to save people, the matter seems settled, but the neighbors each tell a different story and the cause of the fire grows more confused, as if someone used the fire to cover something.
02547: A beggar hands a disciple a secret letter from the sect
02548: A beggar on a street corner suddenly hands over a short note, saying only that someone wants the disciple to open it in person. The handwriting is hasty, yet it touches on a few old matters passed down only within the sect. It has to be treated with care.
02549: A disciple finds precious herbs that others covet
02550: Passing a barren slope, the disciple catches a strange fragrance; parting the weeds reveals a few rare medicinal herbs. Unfortunately, footprints linger not far off. Clearly someone else has their eye on this place.
02551: A disciple hears a woman cry for help while staying at an abandoned inn
02552: Wind leaks through the broken windows of the old inn, and in the night a woman's faint crying can be heard. The other travelers all say the place is unlucky, but the crying seems to hold a plea for help, leaving one torn.
02553: A disciple comes upon a crowd fighting over a wooden chest on a riverbank
02554: Just after a downpour, a broken wooden chest washes up on the riverbank, and a few idlers are grabbing at it. No one has seen what's inside yet, but tempers are already frayed; one wrong move could start a brawl.
02555: A disciple accidentally keeps a token and draws people demanding it back
02556: In a hurry to leave, a traveling merchant mistakenly leaves a personal token in the disciple's hands. Before long, someone follows the trail and comes demanding it, very urgently, as if that small thing is tied to more than one interest.
02557: A disciple escorts a scholar on his way to the exams who is being followed
02558: A scholar on his way to the imperial exams hurries along with a book chest on his back, looking frightened. He says he has been followed lately and only asks the disciple to travel with him for a while. It seems a small matter, but what the scholar carries close to his chest doesn't seem ordinary.
02559: A disciple takes the stage at a festival arena to fight
02560: Crowds pack the arena set up for the festival, and the organizer loudly announces a prize for the winner. If the disciple accepts and takes the stage, it's not just about winning or losing; there's no escaping the eyes of every side.
02561: A disciple sees through an alms-begging monk's disguise
02562: The alms-begging monk in the street talks and moves rather unnaturally. His kasaya is neat, but his eyes look more like those of a seasoned jianghu hand. After a few more looks, the disciple feels sure this man is after far more than a few bowls of vegetarian food.
02563: A disciple follows a trail of blood in the snow to find the wounded
02564: In the wind and snow, a line of footprints of uneven depth runs across the snow ahead, as if someone fled while wounded. The sky is darkening; if no one follows soon, the wind and snow will wipe out this clue entirely.
02565: A disciple hears jianghu secrets on the post road
02566: Resting on the way, the disciple hears traveling merchants quietly discussing a jianghu rumor that has only just spread. The speakers are very secretive and the listeners half believe it, yet ignoring it entirely seems a pity.
02567: A disciple escorts a medicine cart that many eyes are following
02568: A medicine merchant is driving his cart along country roads and, worried about being robbed, offers the disciple a small fee to escort him for a while. It seems just a stretch traveled together, but more and more watching eyes follow along the road.
02569: A disciple is challenged by a sabersman at a roadside inn
02570: In a remote roadside inn, a man with a saber, emboldened by drink, picks out passing martial artists to test. His saber intent is sharp, and the drink can't hide the edge in his eyes. Clearly he is no ordinary thug.
02571: A beggar points a disciple down a side road to something strange
02572: A beggar at the street corner mysteriously points down a side road, saying something "interesting" just happened over there. His tone has a bit of hoping for a tip in it, and a bit of the onlooker who loves a good commotion.
02573: A disciple follows a torn map to a mysterious old place
02574: An old map quietly appears in a corner of the market. The paper is yellowed and the ink mottled, yet it marks an old place few ever mention. Real or fake, the only way to know is to go and see.
02575: A disciple escorts a coffin along a mountain road at night
02576: The charity mortuary is short-handed at night and asks the disciple to help escort a coffin that was left there for the time being. The night is deep and the mountain road silent; the farther they go, the more unnerving it gets.
02577: A disciple follows the sound of a zither to a hermit in the woods
02578: Zither music drifts from deep in a wild forest. Following it, the disciple finds a hermit in plain clothes sitting alone by a rock. He seems to have deep insight but won't say it outright, leaving only a hint in his words.
02579: A disciple is asked to look into strange happenings in a great house
02580: A servant from some great house suddenly comes asking for help, saying only that things have not been peaceful in the household lately and hoping the disciple will take a look. Everyone inside and outside the gate is talking, but no one will say all they know.
02581: An old woman asks a disciple to get to the bottom of strange happenings at her home
02582: By a guttering lamp on the riverbank, an old woman is burning incense and praying alone. Seeing the disciple pass, she comes over to plead: strange things keep happening in her home lately, and she only hopes someone can find out the truth for her.
02583: A disciple finds a street performer with real martial skill
02584: In a troupe of performers in the busy market, one person's tumbling looks ordinary, yet every move and step clearly follows a proper fist stance. If the disciple stops to look closely, it's clear this spectacle may be more than a spectacle.
02585: A disciple helps village militia hunt down a roving criminal
02586: A band of village militia chasing a roving criminal is short of hands and asks the disciple for help. Helping would earn merit, and would certainly mean a face-to-face clash with the villain.
02587: A gambling house ledger vanishes mysteriously at the change of shift
02588: At the door of a small-town gambling house, the disciple finds the manager frantic: the ledger recording debts vanished during the change of shift. The gamblers each tell a different story, and even the doorman can't say who took advantage of the confusion.
02589: Two medicine sellers quarrel over whether a prescription is genuine
02590: Two medicine sellers south of the city are red in the face over a much-sought herb. One accuses the other of swapping prescriptions; the other insists someone framed them on purpose. Bystanders all hope someone who knows the trade will step in and judge fairly.
02591: A small boat at the old ferry is long overdue at midnight
02592: As night settles on the river, only one guttering lamp still sways at the old ferry landing. The old ferryman is anxious: a small boat should have come back to shore but there's still no sign of it. The water is pitch black, and the longer one waits, the tighter the heart grows.
02593: A sabersman at an inn mistakes someone for an enemy and draws his blade
02594: As the disciple checks into an inn, the sound of a blade being drawn suddenly comes from the next room. A sabersman has mistaken a merchant staying there for an old enemy. Neither will back down first, and the whole hall of diners has fallen silent in fright.
02595: A disciple picks up a locked box in a secluded alley
02596: Puddles still stand in the secluded alley, and at the foot of a wall the disciple's hand finds a small locked wooden box. It is badly worn, as if someone hid it in a hurry, yet there is no sign of an owner coming back to look for it.
02597: A disciple finds a torn letter in a book while sheltering from rain
02598: Steady night rain drives the disciple under the eaves of a bookshop. The shopkeeper, counting old volumes by a dim lamp, suddenly turns up a torn letter tucked inside a book. The writing breaks off here and there, yet it seems tied to a past someone has deliberately covered up.
02599: A storyteller's old tale makes a mysterious guest turn pale
02600: Warming to his tale in a teahouse, the storyteller suddenly mentions a bold hero famous in the region years ago, of whom only rumors of doubtful truth remain. The audience all take it as a story, except one person in the corner whose face clearly changes.
02601: River porters come to blows over wages
02602: At the river landing, a few porters are quarreling over an unfair split of a heavy load, and the thud of carrying poles hitting the ground is harsh. Some say the foreman docked their pay, others blame the new hands for slacking. It looks about to turn into a free-for-all.
02603: Strange sounds come from a disused well in an abandoned house every night
02604: The disused well in the backyard of an abandoned house has long been ignored, but lately strange echoes rise from it every night. The neighbors say it's haunted, but an old woman quietly asks the disciple to look, fearing that what's hidden at the bottom isn't a wronged ghost but a secret that can't see the light.
02606: The market was hosting a charity sale where villagers raised money for the needy, but as the stalls are packing up, someone suddenly claims some of the money is missing. The few people who handled it don't look well, the watching villagers whisper among themselves, and no one wants to be the first to come under suspicion.
02607: A disciple runs into an escaped convict at Chengdu's city gate
02608: The disciple arrives in Chengdu just as the gate constables are hunting an escaped convict through the night. Torches light up the gateway, every passing merchant and traveler is stopped and searched, and yet someone is trying to slip out of the city in the confusion.
02609: A disciple sees an assassination on a painted boat during a night out on West Lake
02610: Strolling by the lake in Hangzhou at night, the disciple suddenly sees the lights on a painted boat thrown into chaos. Someone at the banquet has leaped up to strike; the music hasn't even stopped, yet the guests are already screaming and scattering.
02611: A disciple finds something suspicious about a fire at the Kaifeng night market
02612: The Kaifeng night market should be bustling, but a shop suddenly catches fire. It isn't a big blaze, but it started right by the back door of a warehouse, and it doesn't look like an accident at all.
02613: A new lead in an old Xiliang case points to an ancient alley
02614: Walking through an old alley in Xiliang, the disciple is stopped by a yamen runner for questioning. An old case unsolved for years has suddenly turned up a new lead, and the lead points to this very unremarkable alley.
02615: Fuzhou dock traders squabble over cargo and are ready to fight
02616: A cargo ship has just docked at Fuzhou, and several traders are already red in the face over who unloads first. Before the disciple gets close, someone is seen quietly calling over hired thugs, as if to turn a fight over goods into a fight to the death.
02617: A merchant caravan vanishes mysteriously on the Zhongdu post road
02618: Stopping on the post road outside Zhongdu, the disciple hears that a caravan has vanished mysteriously, people, goods and all. There are no clear signs of a fight along the way, which makes it seem all the more like an inside job.
02619: A disciple is invited to test swords at Wudang's Sect Gate
02620: A sword-testing platform has been set up before the Sect Gate on Mount Wudang. The disciple on the gate speaks neither humbly nor arrogantly, saying only that any visiting traveler with skill is welcome to step up and test their edge. With all eyes watching, there's no easy way to step back or forward.
02621: An intruder's footprints are found in the forbidden corridor of Xiyue Peak
02622: After nightfall on Xiyue Peak, the bells fall quiet, but the night patrol finds strange footprints in the inner courtyard. The trail leads to the forbidden corridor. Clearly someone has slipped in under cover of night.
02623: A disciple overhears a secret talk in a side hall at Lingyun Summit
02624: Passing a side hall at Lingyun Summit, the disciple happens to hear an argument in lowered voices inside. Shadows move behind the crack in the door, as if they are discussing some big matter that shouldn't see the light.
02625: An herb-gathering disciple goes missing on the back slopes of Mount Shaoshi
02626: The herb garden on the back slopes of Mount Shaoshi lies close to a sheer cliff, and a disciple who went gathering herbs has not come back. Beside the mountain path are only half a herb basket and scattered footprints. It hardly looks like simply getting lost.
02627: A bold outsider makes trouble before Tangjia Fort
02628: As soon as the disciple reaches the gate of Tangjia Fort, someone calls out loudly. A bold outsider is openly set on challenging the fort to a fight at its gate, repeatedly demanding to see real skill.
02629: A former Qingcheng retainer blocks the road over an old grudge
02630: The mist hasn't cleared from the paths of Mount Qingcheng when a middle-aged man calling himself a former retainer of the sect suddenly blocks the way. All he talks of is an old grudge; everything he says makes it plain he has come for an answer.
02631: A secret old relic is stolen from the Emei storehouse
02632: Lodging on Mount Emei, the disciple arrives just as the storehouse count comes up short. The storehouse keeper is pale: what's missing isn't gold or silver, but an old object that must not get out lightly.
02633: A disciple is invited to fight on the Fuhu Sect's arena stage
02634: Crowds roar below the arena on Fuhu Ridge, and the stage master announces to all that anyone with the nerve to step up can make a name in a single fight. The moment the disciple appears, someone on the stage cups fist in palm from afar in invitation.
02635: A disciple strays into Xingtai Mountain's forbidden ground and is watched
02636: The disciple strays into the forbidden area of Xingtai Mountain. A mountain wind blows, and all around it suddenly goes strangely quiet. The guards haven't shown themselves yet, but several pairs of eyes in the shadows have already settled on the disciple.
02637: A disciple discovers an ambush on the mountain road at Fengling Ferry
02638: As the disciple nears Fengling Ferry, a patrol suddenly calls a warning from behind the rocks. Soldiers have been lying in ambush on the mountain road ahead for some time, just waiting for someone to pass.
02639: Strange signs appear in a secluded elder's meditation chamber at Yanzi Hollow
02640: Word has spread from Yanzi Hollow that strange things keep happening in the chamber of an elder in secluded training, with a faint light shining through the window at night. The disciples there don't dare disturb the elder and can only quietly ask for help in telling whether it bodes good or ill.
02641: A visitor from Tianshan braves the snow to beg a disciple to save a life
02642: Spending the night at the foot of Tianshan, the disciple hears someone pounding urgently on the door in the snowstorm at midnight. The visitor, wrapped in cold, says only that someone in the mountains is hanging by a thread and that they had to come down in the night to find help.
02643: A gambler at Jilin Village turns nasty after losing
02644: Just as the disciple enters the town gate of Jilin Village, a crowd outside the gambling house is pounding tables and cursing each other. Someone who lost badly has turned nasty and refuses to pay, and even the house has been forced back behind the door.
02645: A squabble over seats among boat passengers at Yunshan Flat hides something else
02646: Several black-awning boats are moored at the landing of Yunshan Flat, but a few passengers can't stop arguing over who boards first. On the surface it's a fight over seats, but listen closely and there seems to be more to it.
02647: A rumor at a Tiemu Slope tea stall alarms a mysterious guest
02648: Resting at a tea stall on Tiemu Slope, the disciple hears the owner mention a rumor in a low voice. Before he's even halfway through, a guest at the next table looks noticeably tense.
02649: Medicinal herbs at Fengyang Ferry are swapped, maybe in a setup
02650: There's an uproar in front of a medicine shop at the Fengyang Ferry market: someone claims the herbs they just bought were swapped. The scale on the counter, the smell of the herbs in the bag and the statements don't match up. The more one looks, the more it seems like a setup.
02651: A disciple sheltering from rain finds someone reached the ruined temple first
02652: On a rainy night, the disciple is forced to shelter in a ruined temple outside the banyan grove, and finds a few guttering lamps still burning in the corner. Someone clearly got there first, yet for some reason only this strange scene remains.
02653: The origin of an old item at the Songfeng Valley pawnshop is a mystery
02654: Browsing old goods at the Songfeng Valley pawnshop, the disciple sees the shopkeeper suddenly bring out from under the counter an old object he won't show anyone. It is very old, and seems to come from somewhere that has no business turning up in a country town.
02655: A traveler vanishes from a locked room in Danxia Stronghold
02656: An uproar breaks out at an inn in Danxia Stronghold in the middle of the night: a guest has vanished without a trace. The door is bolted from the inside, yet the traveler's bundle is left neatly in place. The more one thinks about it, the less right it seems.
02657: Wutou Village militia ask a disciple to hunt down roving bandits
02658: The captain of the Wutou Village militia is at his wits' end over catching roving bandits. Seeing the disciple pass, he quickly asks for help: the bandits know the land, and every time they're cornered they slip away into the woods.
02659: A disciple is shaken down crossing a disused bridge at Shuke Village
02660: Crossing a disused bridge at Shuke Village, the disciple is stopped by a few loafers standing in the middle of it demanding money. The bridge is narrow and the water fast, with no way around either end; this time there's clearly nothing to do but face it.
02661: Two groups of drinkers overturn tables and brawl in Xuanshi Stronghold
02662: The wine shop in Xuanshi Stronghold reeks of liquor, and two groups of drinkers suddenly overturn tables and come to blows over a casual remark. The waiters can't stop them and can only watch as wine jars and stools are smashed all over the floor.
02663: Swapped offerings at the Kuiyu Town ancestral hall spark a clash
02664: The rite at the Kuiyu Town ancestral hall should be solemn, but someone publicly accuses others of swapping the offerings. The clan elders are furious and the side branches refuse to accept it; before the rite is done, the clash has already reached the altar.
02665: A troupe's lead actor at Cuiquan Hollow vanishes before the show
02666: Backstage at the Cuiquan Hollow theater is in chaos, and the troupe master is sweating with worry. The lead actor suddenly disappeared just before the show, leaving only half a note and a stage costume of unknown origin.
02667: A mine tunnel collapses at Yutian Township, trapping people
02668: Passing the mine at Yutian Township, the disciple arrives just as the mountainside caves in. The dust hasn't settled and broken cries for help still come from inside. Every second counts.
02669: A mountain-goods dealer at Shazao Village suspects others of colluding to drive prices down
02670: In front of the mountain-goods shop at Shazao Village, several sellers are fighting fiercely over prices being pushed down. Some suspect the weights have been tampered with; others insist the traders colluded to rig the market.
02671: An old fisherman at Daoxiang Village accuses a rival of selling fakes
02672: The fish market at Daoxiang Village reeks of fish, and an old fisherman publicly accuses a rival of passing off fakes as deep-water delicacies. More and more onlookers gather, and the stall is so noisy it nearly comes to blows.
02673: Staying the night at the Niujia Manor mortuary, a disciple hears a coffin knock
02674: Spending the night at the Niujia Manor mortuary, the disciple hears a faint knock beside a coffin at the third watch. The night watchman has gone white and says only that lately, whenever the sky is overcast, there are always strange noises no one can explain.
02675: Exam papers at the Xiaoling Shoal village school are stolen in the night
02676: The teacher at the Xiaoling Shoal village school is stamping his feet over his scrolls: the exam papers needed tomorrow have vanished tonight. The desk, windows and doors are all intact, which makes the theft all the stranger.
02677: An old well at Qingniu Gully makes strange sounds every night
02678: The old well at Qingniu Gully has been half-abandoned for a long time, yet lately hollow echoes often come from it deep in the night. The villagers can't agree: some say a ghost hides at the bottom, others that someone is using the well for something.
02679: A Luwan Village hunter asks a disciple to gather herbs in the mountains
02680: A hunter from Luwan Village carrying an empty herb basket stops the disciple to ask for help. Someone injured in the mountains badly needs a certain herb, but the animal tracks in the woods have been chaotic lately, and even old hunters dare not go in carelessly.
02681: Baixi Ferry porters fight over the unloading order
02682: The porters at Baixi Ferry are red in the face over the order of unloading, and the foreman still won't show up. Crates sit piled on the bank where no one dares touch them; it could blow up at any moment.
02683: A Yuwan Village child gets lost in the temple fair crowd
02684: Just as the temple fair is at its liveliest, cries ring out in Yuwan Village that a child has gone missing. Gongs, drums and the crowd are all mixed together; the longer it drags on, the harder the search will get.
02685: A night watchman at the Zhubei Village granary runs into a thief
02686: The night wind howls outside the Zhubei Village granary, and the night watchman spots a thief's shadow in the dark. The thief has clearly scouted the way already and is just waiting for the guard to slacken to strike.
02687: Found a priceless treasure that's the envy of all
02689: On the way to the city, the disciple chatted for half a day with a peddler on the same road and learned what several of the city's shops pay for their stock. This shopping trip should knock a bit off the prices.
02691: In a roadside tea shed, someone was selling an "ancient inkstone from the last dynasty". The disciple saw at a glance it was new work made to look old and said so in front of everyone. Word reached the city, and none of the shopkeepers dare quote this expert a padded price now.
02693: On the highway outside the city, a cart got stuck in a muddy pit and the disciple lent a hand. The carter turned out to work for a trading house in the city. He thanked the disciple again and again and said that once in the city, giving his master's name would make the prices easy to settle.
02695: At the third bend of the mountain road, two logs suddenly rolled down the cliff and blocked the way back. A dozen lackeys crawled out from behind the rocks. Their leader, a one-eyed man with a ghost-head saber on his shoulder, spat and said, "The chief's short on cash these days. Everyone passing through leaves something behind."
02696: Disciple Ambushed by the Demonic Cult at a Ruined Shrine
02697: At the third watch, the insects outside the ruined shrine fell silent all at once. The disciple rose with a hand on the sword. A wisp of sweet, bloody-smelling mist seeped through the crack in the door, and four pale-faced figures in black stood in the courtyard, blood-red lotuses embroidered on their cuffs. Their leader laughed. "The heart's blood of a disciple from a great sect is the best thing for raising Gu."
02698: An Enemy's Son Demands a Duel in the Street
02699: A young man in white blocked the way on the long street. He still wore a mourning sash at his waist, but the short sword in his hand was perfectly steady. He named a man and said his father had died ten years ago by our sect's sword. Today he would not ask who was right or wrong. He only wanted a fight. The shops along the street put up their shutters one after another.
02700: Disciple Stumbles into a Murder Inn in a Deserted Village
02701: The landlady of the inn in the deserted village was far too eager to please. When the bowl of mutton soup came, an odd, oily sheen floated on top. The disciple took one sip and felt the root of the tongue go numb. When the disciple looked up, the chopping in the back kitchen had stopped, and three bare-chested men stood in the doorway.
02702: Disciple Attacked by Masked Men While Crossing the River
02703: In the middle of the river, the boatman suddenly dropped the oar and jumped into the water. Three fast boats shot out of the reeds. The masked men at their bows said nothing and went straight for the kill. One of them used a palm technique the disciple had clearly seen at another sect's martial display.
02704: Rival Sect's Disciples Set Up a Checkpoint and Demand the Disciple's Sword
02705: A bamboo shed stood beside the boundary marker, and a dozen disciples with swords guarded the road, questioning every traveler. Once they recognized which sect the newcomer came from, their senior brother sneered. The two sects still had old scores to settle, he said: either hand over the sword and cross the border on foot, or trade a few moves right here.
02706: Disciple's Purse Cut While Watching a Show
02707: A puppet show was playing on a stage in front of the City God Temple, and the crowd was packed tight. At the liveliest part, the disciple felt a light bump at the waist but paid it no mind. After the show, the disciple reached down and found the purse cut clean away, with only half a cord still hanging from the belt.
02708: Disciple Catches Miasma Fever and Is Bedridden for Days
02709: After days on the road and two nights sleeping rough in the woods, the disciple woke that day feeling dizzy and unsteady, with a frighteningly hot forehead. The doctor the innkeeper called shook his head and said it was miasma fever. He prescribed three doses of bitter medicine, and the disciple lay in bed for five or six days, paying for both the medicine and the room the whole time.
02710: Disciple Tries to Break Up a Fight and Takes a Heavy Palm
02711: Two groups of escorts in a restaurant came to blows over seats. The disciple stepped in to separate them, and a man with a pockmarked face turned and struck with his palm. The force was strangely heavy. The disciple staggered back three steps before finding footing, and that night the right shoulder was too swollen to lift. It took several visits to a bonesetter to work it loose.
02712: Disciple Lured into a Gambling Trap by a Sworn Brother
02713: A man in a blue robe staying at the same inn spent money freely, and within a few days he was calling the disciple brother. That night he took the disciple to a gambling den to watch a few rounds. The disciple won a little in the first hands, got carried away and placed a big bet. When the dice cup lifted, the whole table was laughing, and the man was long gone.
02714: Flash Flood Washes Out a Bridge and the Disciple Detours
02715: After a night of mountain rain, the disciple reached the stream mouth early in the morning to find the wooden bridge swept away, with only two posts left. The disciple had to turn into the old forest and take the long way around. Three days later the rations ran out, and only after meeting a band of hunters and trading copper for a few strips of dried river deer meat did the disciple make it out of the mountains.
02716: Disciple Stops a Bolting Horse and Gets Extorted by a Rich Squire
02717: A startled horse charged through the busy market. The disciple leaped up and grabbed the reins, and the horse's head swung aside, knocking over a servant nearby. The servant belonged to Squire Zhao's household in the city and lay there refusing to get up. The squire brought his men, surrounded the disciple and kept insisting on going to the magistrate. In the end the disciple had to pay a large sum for "medicine" to settle it.
02718: Disciple Hears Escorts in a Tavern Talk of a Sect's Debts
02719: In a corner of the tavern, two escorts had drunk themselves red in the face and were swapping stories from recent jobs. One lowered his voice and said that a certain sect's master claimed to be in seclusion but in fact the sect's books were in deficit, and he was borrowing silver from money shops everywhere. The disciple kept eating noodles, head down, and remembered every word.
02720: Old Courier Complains of a Sect's Constant Urgent Letters
02721: While the horses were changed at the post station, the old courier gulped cold tea and grumbled. Of the letters he'd carried to the city this month, six out of ten bore the same sect's wax seal, with an extra iron stamp pressed on the fold, the kind used only for urgent matters. He smacked his lips and said something was bound to happen.
02722: Another Sect's Elder Hosts a Banquet to Sound Out Our Sect
02723: An elder of a sect in the city held a simple dinner. At the table he pressed food but not wine, yet his talk kept circling back to our Sect Master's recent doings and how many hands the sect had. The disciple's answers gave nothing away. As the meal ended, the elder, a little drunk, leaned on the disciple to the door, and a page of a roster slid from his sleeve. The disciple took one look and memorized it.
02724: Disciple Joins a Hero in a Bamboo Hat to Raid a Bandit Camp at Night
02725: Wailing filled the village entrance: bandits from the mountain had carried off the village head's daughter. A man in a bamboo hat listened in silence, then took up his sword and headed up the mountain. The disciple followed and watched him break open the camp gate in seven strokes. At dawn the girl was brought back to the village. The man left no name and led a thin horse away to the north.
02726: Disciple Sees Sword Intent on a Broken Stele in an Ancient Tomb
02727: On a barren hill, an ancient tomb had long since been dug open, and the broken stele in front of it lay in the weeds, its inscription weathered down to half. The disciple brushed away the moss and saw faint traces of a sword's edge where the strokes turned. The longer the disciple looked, the more it resembled a sword technique, and the disciple sat before the stele for most of the day.
02728: Disciple Spots the Arena Champion's Flaw and Wins on the Underdog
02729: The town's arena had run for three days, with a betting table below the stage and a long line of people backing the iron-armed man who had won nine in a row. After watching two bouts, the disciple noticed that before every punch his left foot tapped forward first, and put money on the thin young challenger. On the third exchange, the iron-armed man was beaten to the first strike, just as expected.
02730: Disciple Hired to Read an Old Grudge Letter in Public
02731: A lame old man handed over a silver ingot and asked the disciple to take a letter to a sect's branch hall in the city and read it aloud before everyone. The letter set out, from start to finish, a bloody affair from twenty years ago. Halfway through, someone in the hall slammed the table and stood up. The silver was earned, but that sect's disciples remembered this face.
02733: In a ruined temple lay a poisoned escort, his lips already purple, still shielding a child of five or six in his arms. He caught the disciple's sleeve and pressed a wooden tag carved with a sect's emblem into the disciple's hand. The child's uncle worked at that sect's gate, he said, and he begged the disciple to take the child there. Before he finished, his hand went slack.
02734: Disciple Makes a Friend in a Fight with a Youth from Another Sect
02735: The disciple and a youth from another sect reached for the same window table at once, and neither would let go first. They fought from upstairs to downstairs while the innkeeper stamped his feet over the damage. When it was over, both of them laughed. The youth ordered two jars of wine and paid the innkeeper for the tables and chairs. They drank until midnight and agreed to meet again in the jianghu.
02736: Peddler Gives a Book to Repay an Old Kindness to Our Sect
02737: The peddler selling needles and thread stared at the disciple's robe for a long while, then suddenly dropped his load and bowed. More than ten years ago bandits had struck his family, he said, and a senior wearing these same clothes had saved them. He had never been able to repay it. He pushed half a hand-copied booklet on the disciple, saying he'd gotten it years ago from a down-and-out scholar. He couldn't read, so it was no use to him.
02738: Disciple Witnesses a Duel Between Two Sects
02739: Two sects agreed to settle a private grudge at the mass grave outside the city. Neither trusted the other's choice of witness, so they finally asked the disciple, an outsider, to serve. Under the moon the two fighters traded more than forty moves, and one slipped and injured the other's meridians. Disciples on both sides were about to draw blades on the spot, and only the disciple's fair ruling sent them home.
02740: One-Armed Exile Teaches the Disciple a Move
02741: A one-armed old man lived in a shack below the river dike. Every evening he drew a few strokes in the sand with a bamboo twig, then wiped them out with his foot. After the disciple brought him food a few times, he admitted he had been expelled from his sect, charged with secretly learning a forbidden move. He told the disciple to watch the sand. Taking this move to the grave, he said, would be too great a waste.
02742: Disciple Joins the Host Sect's Morning Drill
02743: At the first crow of the rooster, the training ground was already full. The host sect's steward put the disciple in the very last row for an hour of stance work. Their style was very different from ours, and at first everything felt awkward. By the fifth day, the disciple could see in their footwork several flaws in our sect's sword moves.
02744: Allied Sect's Elder Summons the Disciple at Night to Discuss the Sword
02745: Someone came at night to say the elder wished to see the guest disciple. Under the lamp, the elder asked only three questions, each about how our sect's sword technique finishes. The disciple stumbled through the answers, and the elder didn't point out the mistakes. Only at the third watch did he draw an arc on the table with a tea spoon and say that this was how your founder originally finished it.
02746: Disciple Allowed to Copy Books in the Scripture Library
02747: For the sake of the two sects' friendship, the host sect let the disciple into the Scripture Library for an hour every afternoon, copying only books from the outer three floors. The old Daoist guarding the library coughed often, and each cough was a reminder that time was nearly up. After half a month, the disciple had filled two booklets, and the wrist ached too much to hold chopsticks.
02748: A Note from an Old Friend
02749: An old man selling flatbread at the city gate recognized the disciple's sect. His son was second manager at a silk shop in the city, he said, and the family had once been helped by our sect. He borrowed a brush and ink and wrote a note, telling the disciple to show it at several shops he knew. No one would dare ask a single coin more.
02751: When the disciple entered the city, the ironmongers on the east and west streets happened to be feuding. One posted a notice cutting prices, and the other went even lower. The disciple asked prices at both. Afraid of losing the customer to the rival, each shopkeeper knocked off a bit more before the disciple even spoke.
02753: The day the disciple entered the city, the merchants' guild was holding its offering to the God of Wealth. Colorful awnings went up at the street corner, and the gongs and drums went on until noon. By the city's old custom, every shop offers discounts for three days after the festival to draw customers, and the shopkeepers greeted even strangers with smiles.

03296: A band of intruders of unknown origin who call themselves the Fengsha Gang made some objects from their homeland as they remember it. This is one of them: a small lamp for a tabletop.

03741: A place to train fist and kick skills, lined with wooden dummies and sandbags, with stone locks and weapon racks in good order. Here disciples punch and kick, throw and grapple, toughening sinew and bone and settling qi and blood. The thud of blows and the battle cries are the martial artist's pursuit of "stopping the spear is true martial virtue". This is both the ground where bodily strength is honed and the starting point for grasping the true heart of the martial path: without solid fist and kick skills, no martial artist's foundation can be built.
03744: A place where saber and sword practitioners are tempered. Blades rest on their racks, their gleam unseen, yet the air is heavy. Saber and sword manuals hang on the walls, and the targets bear the scars of countless strokes. "Hiding the edge" does not mean dulling it; it means cultivating the state of "still as a mountain when held back, swift as thunder when unleashed": a saber that splits mountains must first control its force, and a sword that pierces a willow leaf must know how to guard. Disciples hone their minds as they hone their blades, blending the sharpness of steel with method and character. The Sword Pavilion is the root of the sect's blade arts; without the flash of sabers and swords, no one becomes a sharp edge in the jianghu.
03747: A training ground for bows, crossbows and darts. Targets stand like a forest, crossbow strings are drawn taut, and dart marks are spread as thick as star trails. Here what matters is "where the eye reaches, the force arrives": draw the bow steady as a rock, loose the crossbow fast as lightning, throw the dart with heart and hand as one. The ancient "Nine Forms of Archery" are passed on here; disciples pace the sand to judge distance and read the wind to fix position, honing the arts of ranged attack and defense. The Archery Training Ground is not only for tempering technique but for learning to seize the initiative in battle: only by beating the enemy from a hundred paces does a sect show its full fighting strength.
03751: A place where internal art practitioners store up qi. Cold jade meditation cushions are laid out in the room, and even before qi is circulated the air is still and heavy. Disciples train their minds as they train their qi, blending the strength of inner force with bearing and character. The Qi Pavilion is the root of the sect's internal arts; without flowing qi, no one becomes a master of the jianghu.
03754: Inside are a plain cotton-and-hemp meditation cushion and two censers that calm the mind. It restores disciples' Insight well, so they can train all kinds of martial arts better.
03757: A place where spear disciples sharpen their skill. Silver spears and iron lances stand on the racks; their tips are not yet raised, yet their momentum soars to the clouds. A spear that breaks a formation must first gather its qi, and a lance that pierces armor must know how to sink its weight. Disciples hone their minds as they hone their lances, blending the keenness of the spear with spear intent and character.
03760: A place where the sect's disciples learn to ride the wind. Wooden posts and waterwheels stand in the courtyard; the body has not yet moved, but the spirit already soars to the sky. "Soaring to the clouds" is not about speed alone, but about the state of "light as a startled swan, steady as a roosting swallow": leaping a high wall takes first drawing up one's qi, and skimming a deep ravine takes knowing how to control the body. Disciples train their minds as they train their steps, blending the deftness of their movement with artistry and character.
